spec_match.rationale: Calls the real DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission() from a user gesture, honours granted/denied per the w3c deviceorientation spec, subscribes to deviceorientation, and even teaches event.absolute frame semantics and the at-risk absolute/permission integration.

interactive.rationale: An enable button drives the real permission call, live alpha/beta/gamma readouts feed a 3D tilt card and spirit level, and clearly-labelled simulation sliders let sensorless devices drive the same visual without faking sensor data.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the gesture-gated permission call, live tilt visualisation, and honesty about desktops with no sensor; all three are implemented, including the 2.5s no-data timeout message.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles gate-absent (legacy direct attach, labelled), denied permission, events-with-all-null-axes, no-data-after-grant timeout, and the relative vs Earth reference frame distinction — an unusually complete failure-mode set.

references.rationale: Sibling links only — the page lacks the https://chromestatus.com/feature/5915984063889408 self-heal link (shared gap across this feature's concepts).

conformance.rationale: The suite's orientation-requestpermission-static and no-argument-callable assertions are this page's exact dependency; the 3 failures in Chromium 141 are the expected absent statics the page honestly banners.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): desktop screenshot shows the visible flag note, legacy-path warn status, idle visuals and em-dash readouts; zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; the enable flow, sliders, and a real sensor stream could not be driven here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts permission granted/honoured-denial, first live data arrival, and the honest no-sensor labelling path.

design_system.rationale: Tokenised colours with a responsive two-to-one column stage, but the default-visible warn status (--accent-amber on --bg-stone, ~3.5:1), granted pill (--bg-ivory on --accent-emerald, ~4.0:1), and the SIMULATION tag (--bg-ivory on --accent-amber, ~3.3:1 at 0.66rem) all miss WCAG AA 4.5:1.

accessibility.rationale: role=status aria-live status, aria-live readout block mirroring the visual tilt as text values, labelled range sliders, and the simulation clearly distinguished in text — the visual-only card/level always has a textual equivalent.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow with the stage collapsing to one column below 560px; desktop 1280×800 clean and honestly labelled as likely sensorless; only the environmental Google Fonts request fails.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus feature link to this page's see-also
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3 requires the chromestatus.com/feature/5915984063889408 self-heal link on every page; this page links siblings only — one-line additive fix.

openQuestions.title: Fix sub-AA contrast on warn status, granted pill, and SIMULATION tag
openQuestions.detail: The default-visible warn status (--accent-amber on --bg-stone) computes ~3.5:1, perm-pill.granted (--bg-ivory on --accent-emerald) ~4.0:1, and the amber SIMULATION tag ~3.3:1 at 0.66rem bold — all under the AA 4.5:1 bar for small text. Darker amber and --text-black on emerald resolve it; the pattern repeats on request-motion.

openQuestions.title: Capture real-device evidence: gate flow on flagged Chrome and a live sensor stream
openQuestions.detail: Neither the requestPermission prompt (needs Chrome 150+ with DeviceOrientationRequestPermission, or iOS Safari) nor live alpha/beta/gamma data (needs a physical device with sensors) is observable in this headless session. On a real phone, record the grant → tilt flow including the granted pill, event counter, and Earth/relative frame label; on a flagged desktop, record the grant-but-no-sensor timeout message.

summary: A rich, honest sensor-permission demo: real gesture-gated requestPermission(), live tilt visualisation with textual readouts, an explicitly-labelled simulation fallback, and thorough failure-mode handling including null-axis devices and the at-risk absolute-frame notes. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): honest legacy-path banner and idle state, clean console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on either class. Real-device and flagged-browser evidence remain to be captured, and the small amber/emerald text pairs need AA fixes.
